description: Get structured Amazon product data via Decodo (formerly Smartproxy) — title, pricing, rating, reviews, images, availability — parsed into JSON. Pass either a full Amazon product URL or an ASIN. BYOK — _apiKey is your Decodo Web Scraping API "username:password" credentials. Example: decodo_amazon_product({ asin: "B09H74FXNW", _apiKey: "user:pass" })

_apiKey.description: Decodo Web Scraping API credentials as "username:password" (from https://dashboard.decodo.com).

asin.description: Amazon ASIN (product identifier), e.g. "B09H74FXNW". Used to build the product URL when `url` is omitted.

domain.description: Amazon marketplace domain used with `asin`, e.g. "com" (default), "co.uk", "de".

geo.description: Proxy exit location as a location name, e.g. "United States". Optional.

url.description: Full Amazon product page URL, e.g. "https://www.amazon.com/dp/B09H74FXNW". Provide this or `asin`.

name: decodo_amazon_product
title: Decodo Amazon Product
